unverified.bore_in: 3.4646 in (88 mm) - GM Impala spec sheet '3.46 x 3.97 / 88 x 101'; Wikipedia '88.0 mm'; GM Authority reprints the GM Powertrain sheet '88.00 x 101.00mm' (same GM source). No third independent source found.
unverified.stroke_in: 3.9764 in (101 mm, GM) - GM '3.97 in / 101 mm'; Wikipedia '100.8 mm' (3.9685 in). Only GM + Wikipedia; small 101 vs 100.8 mm discrepancy.
unverified.displacement_ci: 150 ci (2,457 cc) - GM '150 / 2457'; Wikipedia '2,457 cc' (= 149.9 ci). NOTE the id's 152 is nominal 2.5 L x 61.02; actual is 150. Only GM + Wikipedia (EPA gives 2.5 L only).
unverified.compression_ratio: GM Impala spec sheets (2014, 2015, 2016): 11.25:1. Wikipedia and the GM Powertrain sheet (via GM Authority): 11.3:1 (rounded). Only 2 independent sources (GM, Wikipedia); they agree within rounding.
unverified.firing_order: 1-3-4-2 - only in the GM Powertrain spec sheet as reprinted by GM Authority. Not found anywhere else.
unverified.block_material: Aluminum - GM spec sheet 'cast aluminum' (2014) / 'lost foam cast aluminum' (2015-16); GM Powertrain text (via GM Authority) 'cast aluminum cylinder block with cast-in iron liners'. Wikipedia mentions only the aluminium bedplate. Only GM confirms.
unverified.head_material: Aluminum - GM spec sheet 'cast aluminum'; GM Powertrain text (via GM Authority) '356T6 aluminum cylinder head'. Only GM.
unverified.fuel_type: Regular unleaded gasoline (E85-capable per GM Powertrain sheet 'E0-E100' via GM Authority) - GM spec 'Recommended fuel: regular unleaded'; Wikipedia 'Gasoline'. Only 2 sources (EPA excluded for fuel).
